title: A lane edit outside its own worktree is refused before it lands in the main checkout
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: lane t-bef2ptx (PR #1405) wrote a draft of src/hook/stop.ts into the main checkout by absolute path before creating its worktree, reverted it, and the edit reappeared; the main checkout stayed dirty, `git pull` failed for the lead, and the lead saved it to .krn/tmp/main-checkout-stop-draft.patch and restored the file. lanes.md already forbids editing the main checkout; nothing enforces it.
Outcome: a PreToolUse guard refuses Edit/Write (and shell redirections it can see) from a lane session to a path outside that lane's worktree, naming the worktree to use.
Proof: a hook test: lane session with worktree W edits <repo>/src/x.ts -> refused with W named; edit inside W -> allowed.
